data.name: Souls of the Dead
data.detailed_description:
A biological catastrophe has engulfed the world, transforming people into bloodthirsty creatures. The only way to stop this plague is to damage the infected's brain. Try to survive this hell – alone or with a partner – while trying to maintain the line between a human and what you're forced to destroy. But remember that every bullet counts, and any mistake can be fatal. Limited resources, constant danger, and the need to balance between brutality and the remnants of humanity – these are the realities of this world.

Souls of the Dead is not only a fight for survival, but a battle for your very soul in a world devoid of hope.

Key Features:

1. Tactical Combat

• Precision strikes to the brain are the only effective way to stop the infected.

• Diverse enemy types: long-infected and surviving humans who can turn into zombies after death.

• Flexible combat style: seamlessly combine firearms, melee attacks, and brutal finishing moves on downed enemies.

• Tactical choices: go in guns blazing or act cautiously, controlling resource consumption.

2. Detailed and Atmospheric World

• Picturesque locations, steeped in tragedy, recreated with elaborate graphics and effects.

3. Resources and Survival

• Scarce Supplies: every bullet, painkiller and bandage can be decisive.

• Dangerous Injuries: bleeding requires immediate stopping and health requires constant monitoring.

4. Cooperative Mode

• Playthrough for two: fight side by side, sharing hardships and hopes.

• Teamwork: distribute roles and cover each other, acting as one.

Developed since 2021 by a single developer.
